title: Purchase Order Template
description: Free GST purchase order format for India with PO number, vendor GSTIN, ship-to address, HSN codes, IGST, delivery date and terms. Use it in Word, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Excel or Overleaf.
features: Vendor, bill-to and ship-to blocks with GSTIN
Itemised table with HSN, unit, rate and IGST total
Delivery, payment and quality terms with authorised signatory
useCases: Ordering raw material and packaging from suppliers
Purchase approvals for SMEs and factories
Matching POs against deliveries and GST invoices
research: References agree on PO number and date, buyer and vendor details with GSTIN, separate ship-to address, line items with HSN, quantity, rate and tax, delivery date and shipping terms, payment terms and an authorised approval signature.

blocks.title: PURCHASE ORDER

blocks.text: Amount in words: **[Rupees One Lakh Fifty-Eight Thousand Eight Hundred Twenty-Eight Only]**

blocks.heading: Terms and conditions
text: 1. **Delivery:** supply the full quantity at the ship-to address by the date above, between 9 am and 5 pm on working days.
2. **Payment:** [45 days] from receipt of goods and a correct GST tax invoice quoting this PO number.
3. **Quality:** goods must match the approved sample and quote; rejected items will be returned at the vendor's cost.
4. **Documents:** send the tax invoice, e-way bill and delivery challan with the consignment.
5. Any change in price, quantity or delivery date needs written approval from our purchase team.
